name: review-topics
title: Review topics
description: What reviewers mention most: topics with how often and how positively, each opening to a real snippet rather than an invented summary.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and topics ({ id, label, mentions, positive, snippet: { quote, author } }); five to eight read well, most mentioned first. A row shows the topic, 'mentioned in 842 reviews' and a bar for the share of positive mentions (0 to 1) with the percentage written beside it followed by the word 'positive' (small and muted, labels.positive), so '94%' always says what it is the share of, for everyone. Each row is a disclosure on the Accordion primitive: it opens to one verbatim snippet and its author, and only one row stays open at a time; the content glides open and shut unless reduced motion is on. A row tints quietly on hover, and the bars are decoration in the foreground tone, so the list reads in monochrome and in dark mode. Uncontrolled with defaultValue (a topic id), or controlled with value and onValueChange. locale formats the numbers, labels the fixed words.
